primary.title: Sold shares, gold or property? Here's how you can legally claim capital gains tax exemption of up to ₹10 crore
primary.summary: Selling assets like shares, mutual funds, gold, or property triggers capital gains tax. Section 54F of the Income Tax Act offers exemptions if long-term profits are reinvested into residential property. Details here.
